tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250thugs rje chen po yang snying 'dus pa'i gnas lung bsdus pa'i skabs rigs drug gnas 'dren mdor bsdus su bya ba'i tshul bzhugs so// 1$0000300na mo gu ru lo ke shwa rā ya/

sbyor ba'i skabs sbyong stegs padma 'dab drug rigs drug gi sa bon bris pa'i dbus su mtshan byang bkod/ zhal zas dang*/ lan chags gtor ma re re 'du bya ba tsam khyad par dang*/ dngos gzhir 'byung bzhi'i dug phyung ba grub nas/ gnas sbyong gnas 'dren dug grib bkru /lan chags 'jal dang chos bshad dang*// phyag bya 'brel thag bcad pa 'o// zhes pa ltar bdun las/ dang po rigs drug gi gnas nas sdug bsngal sbyong ba ni/ bdag nyid rgyal ba thams cad kyi ngo bo thugs rje chen po yin pa la rnam pa thub pa drug gi sprul pa'i sprin phung cir yang 'phro ba'i skur gyur par bsam la/ hūm̐ hrīḥ nga ni bde gshegs yongs rdzogs spyan ras gzigs// 'gro kun ma lus thugs rjes bzung slad du// rigs drug 'dren pa thub chen drug po yin// gang 'dul sku dang phyag mtshan cir yang ston// tshe 'das lus bor rigs drug sdug bsngal sbyong*// oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥ zhes ye ge bdun pa dang*/ kaṃ ka ni'i rjes su/ tshe 'das rigs drug gi sdug bsngal thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad dam ci 'grub bzla/ bdag dang dkyil 'khor pa'i thugs rje'i 'od zer gyis rigs drug gi las sgrib sdug bsngal sbyang bar mos la bye mas brab/ gnyis pa gnas nas 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐/ nyon cig tshe 'das lus brjes rigs kyi bu// sngon tshe nyon mongs dbang gis sdig spyad pas// rigs drug skyes sam sdug bsngal ya re nga*// 'dir shog skyabs gsol mchog gi thugs rjes bzung*// oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥ a su nṛ tri pre duḥ.ā karṣa ya dza dzaḥ gsum mam bdun brjod/ gsum pa sdig sgrib bkru ba ni/ me long dang las bum thogs la/ hūm̐/ rang bzhin chos sku'i bum pa bzang po nas// yan lag brgyad ldan dri med dge ba'i chus// tshe 'das khrus gsol nyon mongs sgrib dag nas// ye shes rnam drug gsal ba'i don rtogs shog

/oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥ tshe 'das rigs drug gi sdug bsngal las sgrib thams cad shuddhe shuddhe bi shuddhe shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ bzhi pa lan chags 'jal ba ni/ thog mar zhal zas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin brlabs la/ hūm̐/ bcom ldan thub chen drug po la// dri med dag pa'i zhal zas dang*// longs spyod rgyan gyi mchod gtor 'bul// tshe 'das sdug bsngal sbyong du gsol// oṃ nai widyā pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa hūm̐/ zhes 'bul/ glud gtor 'bru gsum dang*/ sambha ra 'i sngags kyis spel zhing bsgyur la/ hūm̐/ 'dod yon lnga ldan glud gtor bzang po 'di// rigs drug lan chags bu lon sbyang phyir bsngo// tshe 'das bsod nams tshogs rdzogs chos spyod cing*// rnam grol 'bras bu'i don la spyod par shog /oṃ sarba bhū ta ba liṃ ta khā hi/ lnga pa chos bshad pa ni/ hūm̐/ tshe 'das khyod nyid gcig pu 'chi snyam ste// kun kyang mi rtag 'chi ba'i chos can yin// bar dor 'khyams pa'i shes pa phyad phyod khyod// lha dang slob dpon dran gyis myur du shog /dge sdig chos la spang len shes par gyis// bdag tu 'dzin pa'i rtog pa rang sar grol// sarba dharma kā ya aḥ drug pa phyag 'tshal du gzhug pa ni nye drung gis byang bu thogs la phyag 'tshal te/ hūm̐/ nyon cig tshe 'das lus brjes rigs kyi bu// bkra shis khang bzang pho brang 'dir shog la// smyug ma 'di ni khyod kyi bla gnas yin// gdugs ni bzhugs gnas 'phan phran lus kyi tshad// mtshan byang gzugs la rnam shes rten chos la// dkyil 'khor lha la phyag 'tshol skyabs su song*// na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta pū ru shā ya hoḥ zhes phyag byas la ming byang dbang stegs su bzhag la/ bdun pa 'brel thag bcad pa ni/ hūm̐/ sa 'di bcad pa man chad rigs drug gnas// sdug bsngal rnam gsum tshan che dar re drags// skye 'chi ya nga las dbang kha re drags// ma chags ma zhen rigs drug 'khor ba spongs// oṃ da ha da ha sarba na ra ka ga te he tuṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/

oṃ pa tsa pa tsa sarba pre ta ka ga te he tuṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma tha ma tha sarba tirya ka ga te he tuṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba duḥkha sarba kle sha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ spa ra bidyān khadga tshindha su hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ spa ra bidyān khadga tshindha a hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes sngags rnams lan gsum bzlas te rigs drug gi dal phyags la skye sgo bcad/ dkon mchog bden pa'i byin rlabs dang*// lha dang sngags kyi thugs rje dang*// rten 'brel zab mo'i nus mthu yis// tshe 'das rigs drug gnas las thar// bla med sku gsum myur thob shog / ces smon lam gdab bo// zhes pa'ang zab gter gyi gzhung 'ga' dang*/ grub pa'i slob dpon rnams kyis kyang rigs drug gnas 'dren bsdus pa'i tshul 'di lta bu sbyar pa mang du mthong ba'i rjes su 'brangs nas gzhung rgyas pa las nye bar bsdus te bris pa dge legs su gyur cig /maṅga laṃ// / /
